can_do_en: I can ask where a street or place is, follow simple directions (straight on, turn at the second corner, on the left or right) and repeat them back.

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.zh: 阿姨，不好意思，請問中正路在哪裡？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄚ ㄧˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄧˋ ˙ㄙ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ
dialogue.en: Excuse me, ma'am, could you tell me where Zhongzheng Road is?

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.zh: 中正路喔？你要去中正路哪裡？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄛ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ
dialogue.en: Zhongzheng Road? Where on Zhongzheng Road are you going?

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.zh: 我要去我朋友家，在中正路三十八號。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄙㄢ ㄕˊ ㄅㄚ ㄏㄠˋ
dialogue.en: I'm going to my friend's place, at 38 Zhongzheng Road.

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.zh: 喔，那裡不遠，走路五分鐘。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄛ ㄋㄚˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄢˇ ㄗㄡˇ ㄌㄨˋ ㄨˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ
dialogue.en: Oh, that's not far. Five minutes on foot.

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.en: Great! How do I get there?

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.zh: 你從這裡一直往前走，到第二個路口右轉，就是中正路。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄓㄜˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄧ ㄓˊ ㄨㄤˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄗㄡˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄦˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄧㄡˋ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄕˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨˋ
dialogue.en: From here go straight ahead, and at the second intersection turn right: that's Zhongzheng Road.

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.zh: 第二個路口右轉，然後呢？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄉㄧˋ ㄦˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄧㄡˋ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄖㄢˊ ㄏㄡˋ ˙ㄋㄜ
dialogue.en: Turn right at the second intersection, and then?

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.zh: 右轉以後，你會看到一家郵局。三十八號就在郵局旁邊。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˋ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄧ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ㄙㄢ ㄕˊ ㄅㄚ ㄏㄠˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ㄆㄤˊ ㄅㄧㄢ
dialogue.en: After you turn right, you'll see a post office. Number 38 is right next to the post office.

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ㄗㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄏㄞˊ ㄕˋ ㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄧㄢ
dialogue.en: On the left of the post office, or the right?

dialogue.speaker: 阿姨
dialogue.zh: 在右邊。看到郵局就到了。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄎㄢˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄐㄩˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄠˋ ˙ㄌㄜ
dialogue.en: On the right. Once you see the post office, you're there.

dialogue.speaker: 大衛
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄒㄧㄝˋ ˙ㄒㄧㄝ ㄚ ㄧˊ

vocab.en: auntie (polite address for a woman of your parents' age)
to turn (左轉 turn left, 右轉 turn right)
to see, to catch sight of

grammar.note_en: 大衛 asks 中正路在哪裡？ and 阿姨 asks back 你要去中正路哪裡？: 哪裡 sits where the place will be in the answer, and neither question takes 嗎.
Every location answer is 在 + place with no 是: 三十八號就在郵局旁邊, 在郵局左邊還是右邊？, 在右邊.
大衛 gives the address big to small, road first and the number with 號 last: 在中正路三十八號.

pronunciation.note_en: Directions are full of ㄐ / ㄓ / ㄗ: 就 ㄐㄧㄡˋ and 家 ㄐㄧㄚ (tongue flat, lips spread), 中正路 ㄓㄨㄥ ㄓㄥˋ and 這裡 ㄓㄜˋ (tongue tip curled back), 走 ㄗㄡˇ, 在 ㄗㄞˋ and 左 ㄗㄨㄛˇ (tongue tip behind the teeth). Many Taiwan speakers say ㄓ close to ㄗ, so 中正 may sound like zong-zeng; understand it, but say ㄓ yourself. Tone pair 3+4 in 走路, 請問, 我要, 你會: keep the third tone low (21) with no rise, then drop from high for the fourth.

speaking.prompt_en: You are at the train station and want to go to the post office. Stop a local, ask where it is and whether it is far, ask how to get there, repeat the directions back, and thank them.
speaking.prompt_zh: 你在火車站，想去郵局。請你問路：郵局在哪裡？遠不遠？怎麼走？再說一次怎麼走，最後說謝謝。
checklist_en: opened politely with 不好意思，請問…
asked …在哪裡？ with no 嗎
repeated one direction back (一直往前走 / 第…個路口右轉 or 左轉)
used 在 + place for a location (在郵局旁邊, 在右邊)
kept 走路 and 請問 low then falling (3+4)

writing.prompt_en: Tell a friend how to walk from your home to a place nearby (a convenience store, the post office or a park). Write two or three sentences.
writing.prompt_zh: 從你家到附近的一個地方（便利商店、郵局、公園）要怎麼走？寫兩、三句。
writing.model_zh: 從我家一直往前走，到第一個路口左轉。便利商店在公園旁邊，走路三分鐘。
writing.model_zhuyin: ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧ ㄓˊ ㄨㄤˇ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄗㄡˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ˙ㄍㄜ ㄌㄨˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄗㄨㄛˇ ㄓㄨㄢˇ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄌㄧˋ ㄕㄤ ㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄩㄢˊ ㄆㄤˊ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄗㄡˇ ㄌㄨˋ ㄙㄢ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ

culture_en: In Taiwan, 不會 or 不會啦 ('not at all') is a very common reply to 謝謝, used alongside 不客氣. 阿姨 'auntie' is a friendly, polite way to address a woman about your parents' age, even a stranger. Most towns in Taiwan have a 中正路 and a 中山路, named after Chiang Kai-shek (蔣中正) and Sun Yat-sen (孫中山), so when you give an address, say which town it is in.
